notes: Pa1d802b211 G4. Printed: '... you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Sorin, Vampire Lord, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' Sorin, Vampire Lord is in seat 0's graveyard. Seat 0 casts the Guide, takes the may and searches the graveyard only (option 2): Sorin goes to seat 0's hand and the library is NOT shuffled, so its order (Card C on top, then Card B, then the fillers) stays exactly as it was. Only seat 0's library is ever searched or shuffled: seat 1's library keeps its exact order.
